tests.name: Independent statistics calculation
tests.description: For sample input and threshold 700, derive each zone result manually.
tests.expected: LAB count=2 peak=800 alerts=1; STUDIO count=2 peak=900 alerts=1.

tests.name: Malformed/duplicate matrix
tests.description: Reject duplicate zone/sample, blank second line, malformed field count, invalid integers and out-of-range values.
tests.expected: SampleFormatException identifies the failing line; identical sample numbers in different zones are valid.

tests.name: Resource and output preservation
tests.description: Use borrowed close-tracking and failing readers; run generate on valid and malformed files with an existing destination.
tests.expected: Borrowed reader stays open; IOException propagates; malformed input leaves destination unchanged.

tests.name: Argument/status contract
tests.description: Exercise correct paths, missing path, malformed source, bad threshold and wrong argument count.
tests.expected: 0 for success, 1 for I/O/data failure and 2 for invalid arguments/threshold.

reasoning: At threshold 700, LAB readings 800 and 700 have one strict exceedance; STUDIO readings 400 and 900 also have one. Both zones have count two and respective peaks 800 and 900.

Sample numbers identify records within a zone. A duplicate composite identifier is rejected, while LAB/1 and STUDIO/1 are different identifiers. Colon cannot appear in a validated zone, so the duplicate-detection key is unambiguous.

Malformed input is a checked I/O-domain failure, not a successful report. The parser reports the physical line and stops; the CLI converts errors to its declared status without manufacturing partial totals.

The parser borrows a Reader. The service closes file resources and delays output creation until validated report lines exist. A later write failure can still leave partial output; this assignment does not promise transactional filesystem replacement.
